newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian trade data backs capex - Costello.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian trade data backs capex - Costello.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Monday the latest trade data, released earlier in the day, confirmed the investment outlook shown in the December quarter capital expenditure survey of business.
"It confirms a good investment outlook in the December capex quarter, showing that expectations for 1996/97 business capital have risen," Costello told parliament.
Seasonally adjusted imports of capital goods grew to A$1.814 billion in January from A$1.410 billion in December, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Monday.
Trend estimates showed capital imports had been tending to rise over the past four months.

Last week, the bureau reported that December quarter business expectations for capital spending for the year to June 1997 were 11.8 percent higher than their corresponding expectations for 1995/96 a year before.
